# Third-party inventory

**Generated. Do not edit — run `./gradlew licenceInventory`.**

Every external module on the release runtime classpath of either application:
what is inside `quiblo-<version>.apk` and `quiblo-tv-<version>.apk`, rather than
what is named in `gradle/libs.versions.toml`. The second list is about forty entries
long and the first is what the attribution obligation actually attaches to.

The reader-facing list, with a note on what each component does, is in the apps'
own settings screens and in `ThirdPartyLicense.kt`. This file is the check on it:
`./gradlew licenceCheck` fails when the two disagree.

Versions are deliberately omitted. They change on every dependency bump and would
make this file a merge conflict rather than a record; what matters here is *which*
components ship.
